text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There's a star in Japan
capable of taking aim at the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe".

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"We will show you just that
at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Representative Exchange Match."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's support, they will surely...
Reach the throne with their own two hands.

text_block_list.name: Internet Comments
text_block_list.text:
"For real, they invited a foreign Umamusume this time?"
"Anyone know her name?" "She's an up-and-comer, right?"
"Who'd be her equivalent in Japan?"

text_block_list.name: Internet Comments
text_block_list.text:
""Besides, won't it give us a taste of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe vibe?"
"Wanna watch?" "...Well, maybe I will."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aided by Mei Satake's energetic PR,
anticipation for Project L'Arc is growing
day by day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the first "Representative Exchange Match."
The members of "Project L'Arc" gathered in the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...From the day this project started until now,
you have shown the world that you have the makings of true stars.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And today, there's a fun race
where those Umamusume will clash in a shower of sparks.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Go ignite the hearts of the people.
Show them that Japan has stars like you
aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden jolt of tension ran through the air.
Then, each Umamusume stepped into their VR Umulator—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tune in!
Can all of you beyond the screen see this?!
This is the virtual ParisLongchamp Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the races will be streamed in real time!
Along with the comments from you spectators!

text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, so high-tech~"
"Amazing. Looks just like the real Longchamp."
"When's the race?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! It's already bustling, I see!
Well then, let us enjoy ourselves to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —The sight of those shining stars racing at Longchamp.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...You came too, huh?
Well, this invite is pretty much perfect training for the Arc, after all."

text_block_list.name: Foreign Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Yes. And while I'm at it, I'll be paying back what I owe you from that last GⅢ race in full."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by unfamiliar Umamusume,
<chrname> stands in a paddock
modeled after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In a race modeled after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, she defeated international contenders and captured the hopes of the people."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Let's take one step closer to the world.
